# Failure-Class Template

Copy this template to open a new failure class in
`docs/learning-loop-registry.md`. One class per recurring failure
pattern — not per incident, not per person.

---

## FC-NNN: <short-name>

- **Title:** <plain-language name>
- **Description:** <what the failure looks like, in plain language>
- **Work types:** <tags matching the kinds of work this affects, e.g.
  `build`, `deploy`, `review`, `docs`, `briefing`>
- **First seen:** <YYYY-MM-DD>
- **Occurrences:** <running count of tagged retrospectives>
- **Rung:** <1 = convention, 2 = checklist, 3 = gate>
- **Containment:** <where the current rung lives — which brief template,
  checklist, review prompt, sensor, or script>
- **Gate ref:** <link or path to the enforcing check, once rung 3 is
  reached; blank before>

### Examples

<Optional. 2–3 brief, anonymized instances showing the pattern. Keep
them generic — no names, no project internals.>
